NO floral circles, gold tile engravings or grunge on tile faces. The exact grid must have EIGHT columns and EIGHT rows. Only two creatures on this board: preserve the original broad-faced moss quadruped Bellback with one dorsal bronze bell on its back, and the original floating ivory ceramic pipe-organ Prism Organ with no humanoid face. Remove the mantis, white stag, bird and mushroom creature entirely. Leave almost all cells empty and visible. Keep rich roots/foliage only outside the board, none over the cells. The purpose is to demonstrate readable tactical negative space instead of a beautiful cluttered diorama. Keep the existing ten small bench slots and five shop illustration windows; don't add figures or new items. Do not increase bloom or elaborate the framing.
